WITH molecule_flags AS (
    
    SELECT
        m."molecule_id",
        MAX(CASE WHEN m."label" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_carcinogenic
    FROM "molecule" m
    GROUP BY m."molecule_id"
),
molecule_chlorine AS (
    
    SELECT
        a."molecule_id",
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(a."element") = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_chlorine
    FROM "atom" a
    GROUP BY a."molecule_id"
)
SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN mf.is_carcinogenic = 1 AND mc.has_chlorine = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(mf."molecule_id")::numeric) * 100 AS percentage
FROM molecule_flags mf
LEFT JOIN molecule_chlorine mc
    ON mf."molecule_id" = mc."molecule_id";

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) AS yr,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) IN (2010, 2011)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp)
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
)
SELECT
    
    (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN cnt END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) * 100)
    -
    (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN cnt END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) * 100)
    AS percentage_difference
FROM yearly
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY t.total_cnt;

724:
SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s

829:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics') AS dc_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics') AS marvel_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics')
      - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');
744:
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT
        p."publisher_name",
        COUNT(s."id") AS hero_count
    FROM "publisher" p
    LEFT JOIN "superhero" s ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
    WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p."publisher_name"
)
SELECT
    
    MAX(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN hero_count ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count,
    
    MAX(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN hero_count ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count,
    
    MAX(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN hero_count ELSE 0 END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN "publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN hero_count ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM counts;
772:
SELECT
    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" AS s

JOIN "gender" AS g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"

JOIN "publisher" AS p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"

JOIN "colour" AS ec ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"

JOIN "colour" AS hc ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"

JOIN "colour" AS sc ON sc."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';

JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"

1451:
WITH member_events AS (
    SELECT
        e."link_to_member",
        COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") AS event_count
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE e."link_to_member" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") > 1
),
member_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e."link_to_member",
        SUM(e."cost") AS total_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE e."link_to_member" IN (SELECT "link_to_member" FROM member_events)
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
)
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mt.total_cost
FROM member_totals mt
JOIN member m ON m."member_id" = mt."link_to_member"
ORDER BY mt.total_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
